resources.string: Lets a bot you paired see this screen and tap, swipe and type for you.

PhoneBridge uses accessibility to read the screen and to perform taps, swipes and typing for the AI bot you paired with this phone. It only works while this service is enabled, only paired bots can send commands, and one bot drives at a time. Turn it off here at any time.
Let your own AI bot use this phone. No central server, end-to-end encrypted.
PhoneBridge needs the accessibility service to see the screen and to tap, swipe and type. Android asks you to switch it on yourself.
Press the test button to check what a bot would see.
Device control is off, so there is nothing to read. Turn on the accessibility service first.
Only bots you pair can send commands. One bot is in control at a time, and you can stop everything from the notification.
